## 819d58220317

**Reproduced teaching shortcut — count only border red markers.**

Audited generator SHA-256: `0a0335764bac6cbe0a75060a6217876e28e7c6ffb2af6f3b19289f5c4b589625`.

The intended rule chooses which nested frame to fill by counting all red marker cells. A simpler rival counts only red markers on the outer grid border. That rival:

- fits all 5/5 canonical labeled pairs, because every canonical red marker is on the grid border;
- fits 600/600 generated samples (200 per difficulty band), because every sampled red marker is also on the border.

The generator validator permits red markers away from the grid border as long as they remain outside the outer frame. I constructed an exact lawful witness from seed `0`, sample index `0`, hard difficulty, with overrides `grid_h=30`, `grid_w=30`, `n_frames=3`, `rank=2`, and `marker_layout="single_side"`. I moved one of the two border markers from `(0,15)` to off-border cell `(1,1)`, still outside the outer frame. `self_check` returned no errors.

The intended count-all-red rule still selects rank 2, while the border-only rival selects rank 1; their outputs differ in 346 cells. The selected Racket target was executed on this input, its rule hash matched catalog hash `0db6b727334d`, and its output exactly matched the intended output in the witness.

Reproducer and evidence:

- `checks/audit/819d58220317/probe.py`
- `checks/audit/819d58220317/report.json`
- `checks/audit/819d58220317/inputs.json`
- `checks/audit/819d58220317/racket_outputs-v2.json`
- `checks/audit/819d58220317/witness.json`

Suggested repair is to emit validator-lawful off-border markers in ordinary lessons, then add the border-only rival to the semantic contract and require it to be refuted under every supported query position. No source was changed for this audit target.
